output.evaluation_rationale: PRO-SUP-01 achieved the highest overall score because it received near‑perfect marks on every evaluation pillar: it scored 100 on both cost and delivery, 95 on risk and capability, and 90 on contract compliance. When these pillar scores are multiplied by their respective weights (the exact weight vector is not shown but is reflected in the total weighted score), the aggregate reaches 97.5, placing it clearly ahead of the competitors. The trade‑off analysis shows that while PRO‑SUP‑02 and PRO‑SUP‑03 offer lower cost scores (82.58 and 69.6 respectively), this cost advantage is offset by modest declines in risk and capability scores. However, the risk score drops from 95 (PRO‑SUP‑01) to 90 (PRO‑SUP‑02) and 75 (PRO‑SUP‑03), suggesting that the cheaper options may carry higher operational or compliance risk. Decision makers must therefore weigh the monetary savings from lower cost against the potential increase in risk exposure; in this case the weighted model favours the balanced, low‑risk profile of PRO‑SUP‑01 despite its higher cost, resulting in its top ranking.
